instructions: After more than 25 years of tasting and testing, perfecting and publishing, staff members at Taste Of Home have had lost of time to compile extraordinary lists of their all-time favorite dishes.These are the recipes they sampled in our Test Kitchen Favorites and you'll enjoy page after page of entrees, snacks, sides and desserts-all deemed best-of-the-best by our staff of experts. You'll event discover the soups, sandwiches, cookies and bars the Taste of Home staff just can't get enough of.From weeknight dinners to holiday feasts, you'll find nothing but perfect satisfying dishes inside. In fact, this brand-new collection offers 142 of the recipes our pros think will become go-to dishes in your home as well
